tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄༅// rug+mak+ṣobisaṃbāderaṃkushanāmashākyaban+deshīlarat+nenāhaṃbhagasamānāyopakār+yakaralikhitakṛtādikapaṭalas+yabargasaṃkhyābidzahāraṃ// ༄༅// shākya'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis rang dang skal mnyam ched du nyer mkho sug bris byas pa rnams phyogs su bsdebs pa'i tshan grangs gser mig 'drid pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄// mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yi ge bcu bdun pa shin tu legs spyod la rigs kyi grangs chig 'bum sum khri stong dang don gnyis/ yi ge sa ya gnyis rjes 'brangs bcas/ lci yang so so sa ya gcig rjes 'brangs bcas/ phyi mo sa ya gsum rjes 'brangs bcas mchis pa'i nang gsel/ naṣ+ṭa bha ta ma ya ta lci zung*/ ud+diṣ+ṭa chig khri drug stong dgu brgya so lnga pa nas rnyed pa'o//

༄༅// prakṛtishud+dhas+yatsit+tāprakṛtas+thaḥpūrbo3dh+wasatwās+t+yāwaraṇobhodzanenashreyasaḥswaprābhābahārā/ ༄༅// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems rgyud rnal gnas sngon dus mi// sgrib gsum bza' bas dge legs rang 'od bral ba rnams// ༄༅// nāyanayānatridhar+m+māṇāṃsukhas+yāsan+yeṣumārgāḥpālayabairotsanayābat+paranīyāhaskaren// ༄༅// bde ba'i go 'phang 'dren byed theg gsum chos kyi lam// ji snyed snang byed 'dren mchog nyin mor byed pas skyongs// thams cad mkhyen kun bskrun byed thog ma'i yab gyur kyang*// bcu drug bgrang gzhir thun mtshams lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg tshul// mi shes rmongs pa rmegs med bcil yang gnas lnga'i yul// legs rtogs blo ster 'jaṃm dpaṃl gzhoṃn nuṃ snying gar rol// bde gnyis rang bzhin dkar 'jam phyag gis bai ḍūr+ya'i// rgyud mangs bsnun pa'i dbyangs dang bsres pa'i snyan dngags glu// 'dzad med rtag par 'jo ba driṃ zaṃ'iṃ bu moṃ yis// longs spyod 'khor lo'i dga' tshal rtsen pa'i skal bzang mdzod// rgyu lam 'bras bu'i chos tshul gsal gzigs legs par 'doms// srid zhi'i dge legs ci yang sbyin mchog thugs rje'i gter// yang dag lam nas 'dong bar 'dod pa kun gyi skyabs// bslu med yon tan mthu ldan dkoṃn mchoṃg gsumaṃ la 'dud// dzam+bu rkang 'thung gis mtshan gling gi gtsug tor 'dir// rgyal bstan dgongs pa mtha' dag dpyad gsum rnam dag gis// legs par 'grel byed smra ba'i rgyal po phyogs kun las// rnam par rgyal ba saṃ skya'iṃ daṃd sgroṃl rim byon dang*// de tshul snang byed zla bral mkha' 'char grangs med dbus// nyin mor byed bzhin ston mchog dam pa'i zhal lung gis// ches cher bsngags pa 'gro 'dul thams cad mkhyen bstan la// mkhas tshul gsum gyi las byas rjeṃ btsunaṃ eṃ waṃ pa// blo chen ngaṃg gi dbaṃng phyug grub pas kunaṃ dga'iṃ dpal// ster byed brtse chen snying po'i tshul chen rtsom 'chad dang*// brtsad pa'i bloṃ groṃs zla bral yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag

/phyogs las rnam rgyalaṃ dge mtshaṃn yi ge phyogs su 'jebs// rgyal bas bstan bya'i snying po sdom gsum 'khor du bcas// nyer gtogs legs par bshad pa'i zil mngar rnam grol gsos// cha shas snying gi yol gor lhung ba skal ba'i ming*// tshul khrims rin chen skad du bod pa'i gyi na pas// mang thos mkhas mchog du ma'i zhabs kyi pad+ma dkar// nyer bsten dad gus lang tsho dar bab bh+ra ma ras// rig pa'i bcud mngar btung bas cher rgyags 'phur lding glu// skal mnyam blo ngor blangs pa'i tshan grangs bstar ba'i tho// gang dag dgos don gnyer ba'i thog mar ming btsal nas// de rjes ming gzhir 'jug pa mkhas pa'i blo gros yin// bza' bas bsgribs pa'i mchil pa la tshags chur 'phyo ba'i// gser mig bzung ba bzod kyi spar mos nam zhig zin// gang phyir nye bar mkho dgu'i rang gzugs skad cig nyid// ston par byed 'dis sngon rabs añja na bu yis// bden bral gzugs dang gzugs brnyan rnam par dpyod pa'i blo// ngal brgyas mnar ba'i dbang rtul go 'phang byin gyis dogs// de'ang skabs su bab pa'i bsnyad par bya ba ni/ shākya'i sras kyi ston pa mchog gi bstan pa 'dir brtul zhugs bzung ba'i btags ming du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pa bdag thog mar rang gi pha mes gong ma'i ring nas lha ris kyi sman 'dogs par byung 'dug pa'i rgyus/ thog ma nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sogs kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur rnams kyi cha tshad kyi gzhung la bslab sbyang dang*/ yi ge 'dri klog dang dag yig za ma tog dang ngag sgron dang sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug dang tshig gter rtsa 'grel sogs ming gi mngon brjod rnams la goms 'dris tsam byas nas gyi nar 'khod pa na las bzang smon lam gyi pho nyas ma bskul gtam snyan 'phrin du shod pa ltar/ 'bru tshe bh+rūṃ chos rje karma mthu stobs 'chi med phrin las bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba phyi nang rig pa'i gnas la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas par bzhugs pa'i grags snyan gzhal du med pa'i chu skyes tshal chen rab tu rgyas pa'i dri bsung gsar pas/

bdag sems kyi bung ba gzhon nu'i snying la sim par brten/ mkhas btsun rgyal ba'i sras chen gong de'i zhabs kyi pad+ma bsnyen 'dun drag po gzhan gyis dbrog tu med pa skyes nas der phyin te/ ji skad du sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rig pa nang par 'chi yang bslab// tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang*// skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi// nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra// zhes gsungs pa rjes su dran pas/ rang gis mngon par 'dod pa'i don ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung kā la pa'i ri mo dang snyan dngags me long dang sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rnams kyi 'grel khrid zhib rgyas/ lañca na dang wartu la yig gzugs 'dri tshul bcas bslab sbyang du stsal to// mi ring bar ngor e waṃ chos ldan du phyin pa na/ mkhan chen shes bya kun mkhyen bsod nams bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'di skad du/ kho bos khyod las sgra dang snyan dngags me long gi rgyan rnams kyi 'gro yul tshar re gzigs dgos zhes bka' stsal phebs pa bzhin/ de dag gi zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang drung yig lhan cig byas nas lo shas der bsdad/ mdo smad ljongs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir yang*/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i sku'i khris su'ang dpe tshan 'ga' zhig gi zhus dag drung yig chabs cig gnas pas/ phyogs kyi yig 'grul rnams kyi yig lan gang 'tsham 'dri ba dang*/ mkhan chen nyid chos 'chad sogs kyis thugs skabs ma byung ba gang tshe/ gtsang dbus phyogs kyi rten gsum rnams la phul ba'i 'phan bla re/ snyan dar sogs kyi zhal yig smon lam rnams dang zhu yig gi rigs rnams 'dri stsol gang lcog gi zham ring pa bgyid pa kho nas las/ rang nyid tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la cung zad sbyangs pa'i nor bu khong du ma chud pa lta bu'i spyi brtol bskyed pa'am/ kha gsags dang gzhogs slong gi sgo nas khe dang grags pa bsgrub 'dod dam/

shes rlom mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi bab bcol lam/ che ba'i go 'phang don du gnyer 'dun gyi blos ma yin pa'ang*/ slob dpon zhi ba'i lhas/ sngon chad ma byung ba'ang 'dir brjod med// sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'ang bdag la yod min te// de phyir gzhan don bsam pa bdag la med// rang gi sems la bsgom phyir ngas 'di brtsams// zhes gsungs ltar rang nyid brjed par dogs pa'i tho dang*/ gzhan gyi gnas skabs kyi dgos don sgrub ched dang*/ 'dod gsol gyi smon lam sogs dgos pa don gnyer gyi re skong tsam dang*/ cho ga sgrub mchod sogs kha gsal 'ga' re dgos pa rnams kyang de dang de'i thad kyi gsal byed shog tshar tsam re ma gtogs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sogs ni kho bo cag lta bus gang dran bris pa zhig gis gzhan la phan 'dogs 'byung re ma mchis mod/ phyis su mkhas btsun chen po mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang po nyid phan bde gling bla brang du bzhugs nas/ der kho bo las snyan dngags me long gi rgyan gyi 'gro yul gzigs dgos zhes gsungs nas/ rtsom rgyug bcas stsal ba'i tshe/ 'di skad du mchid pa thos te/ khyod kyis rtsom chos byas pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ 'dod gsol gyi rigs dang yig lan bris pa bla ma mi chen 'ga' zhig la 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig bris pa rnams dpe chod byas pa yod dam zhes phebs par/ ci yang bris pa med do zhus par/ de lta bu'i le lo byed pa re ma legs/ da lta phan chad gang bris pa rnams dpe chod tsam re byas nas slar phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas bzhag na/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na'ang*/ zhu yig la sogs pa'ang grong tshig gi brjod pa dang sla chos su byas par mi 'gro bar skad gnyis sbyar ba dang snyan dngags kyi rgyan las drangs nas grwa sa chen po'i yig bskur lugs kyi bstan pa'i srol rgyun bzang po mi nub par gnas pa'i ched dang*/ blo gsal gzhan dag la'ang phan pa'i rgyur 'gro bas de ltar yid 'jog gyis zhes bkas gnang ba legs par stsal to// 'dren mchog dam pa de nyid las/

rgyud sde'i dbang bskur mang po'i bka' drin thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' ni shin tu mnyan 'os yin par bcas sngar bris pa rnams ni bstod pa gnyis gsum tsam min pa nyar tshag mtshungs la/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa lug gi bgrang gzhi shar ba mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang sku gshegs rjes tshun nas zhu yig tshig lhug pa bsgrigs legs byas pa rnams kyang dgos pa chung bar bsams nas ma bris pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'ang snga mgyogs su btang dgos pa rnams dang*/ 'dri bar mi 'os pa'i rigs 'ga' ni ma bris kyang de dag ma yin pa'i thun mong du 'dri bar 'os pa'i rigs dang*/ don gnyer dag gi ngor/ 'don chog pa rnams kyis lag tu mi longs pa'i rigs 'ga' rer dkyus kyi steng du mchan bu dang shog tshar dgos zer ba ltar bris pa rnams kyang phyis su bltas pa na/ gzhan gyis rtog dpyod ma byas par mchan dang shog tshar dkyus su bris pa rgyun 'byams su 'gro snyam pa 'ga' re'ang mthong byung bar/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab kyi gseb tshags su gzhan gyi lag rjes bslad pa'i nyes pa byung dogs kyis 'gyod gzhi che ba skyes nas/ de tshun nas gsal byed dang*/ 'don bya rgyas bsdus bar ma'i rnam par gzhag pa'i gsal byed dgos pa'i rigs dang*/ bsngags 'os rnams la bstod pa dang*/ gsol mchod la sogs pa'i cho ga gsar bskrun byas pa nyung shas byung ba 'ga' re rnams/ rang dang rang gi nye bar gnas pa dge slong kun dga' bsam gtan dang*/ lhun grub phun tshogs gnyis kyis rang gis bris pa/ gzhan 'drir bcug nas bsags pa'i khul byas pa 'di dag rnams te/ 'on kyang 'di rnams par du brko ba zhig ma byung na phan 'dogs chung bar bsams nas/ ji skad du/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang mdor bstan las/ gang na sa phyogs chos ldan zhing*// gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa'i// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes 'byung ba ltar dge legs kyi bya ba gang dang gang brtsams kyang chos ldan rgyal por ma bsten par rang dgas ngal ba brgya phrag mang pos bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/

'dir yang sde dge par khang pa'i par dpon dge slong tshul khrims ting 'dzin sar brgyud de/ zla bral bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po/ khri chen sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho pa lcam dral gyi snyan dbang rin po cher/ 'di skad du gsol te/ zham ring ba bdag gis zhu dag byed pa sogs kyi skabs gsing rnams nas/ rang dang skal mnyam gyi las dang po pa'i slob dpon dang*/ grwa rigs slob gsar rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ chos kyi brgyud pa'i thos yig rnams kyi kha 'gengs dang*/ 'don chog skor gyi gsal byed/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor dang*/ rten bzhengs rnams kyi dkar chag 'dod gsol/ 'phrin yig sogs nyer mkho sug bris su byas pa nyung shas mchis pa 'di rnams kyang par du brko ba zhig stsal na/ gsar bu dpe tshogs mi 'dzom pa 'ga' la phan 'dogs 'byung las che zhes gsol ba na/ chos ldan bstan pa'i sbyin po nyid nas/ ji skad du legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las/ rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms shing*// rgyal po'i bang mdzod nor gyis min// 'dod yon spyad pas mi ngoms te// mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi ngoms// zhes 'byung ba ltar 'di tsam la thugs dgyes chen po'i zhal gyi 'dzum zer zla 'od dkar po'i drwa bas bsu ba snyam byed pas/ de 'dras gzhan la phan 'dogs 'byung 'gro bas par du brko bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal phebs pa ltar/ thun mong du par la 'khod rung rnams ris su bsdebs nas/ da lta glegs bam du bsgrigs pa 'di dag lags so// ༈ /de la glegs bam dang po ka rtags can la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter zhes bya ba'i thog mar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po cher 'jug pa'i sgo dang po mdo rtsa bar/ dge bsnyen nyid dang*/ dge tshul nyid dang*/ dge slong nyid dag gis snga ma bsnyen par ma rdzogs par phyi ma mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar kun gyi sngon du 'gro ba dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa'i brgyud pa nas brtsams te/

gser chos gsung ngag rin po che'i chos skor thos pa'i brgyud rim gyi bar sargag nyer gcig pa yan chad la ldeb bu sum 343 brgya zhe gsum yod do// ༈ /glegs bam gnyis pa kha rtags can la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter zhes bya ba'i thog mar/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang nas/ ji skad du rje tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ rnal 'byor mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye ba'i lam// sdig can thar par 'khrid pa'i gsang lam mchog /nā ro ta pa'i chig brgyud snying gi gtam// sa skya'i bla chen brgyud pa'i gser chos 'di// zhes gsungs pa ltar zab lam kun gyi mthar thug pa brtson 'grus dang bstun pa'i bye brag gis tshe 'dir mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang bgrod pa'i nye lam/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gdams ngag gi brgyud pa'i rim pa nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i lung thob pa'i brgyud rim gyi bar yan chad la ldeb bu nyis 290 brgya dgu bcu yod do// ༈ /glegs bam gsum pa ga rtags can la/ sa 1 ngas rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa tshigs su bcad pa rin chen don 'dus zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod pa nyung ngu don 'dus bcas/ grub 12 brnyes brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba tshogs zung rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla 'od/ gsung 15 ngag rin po che'i zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchod pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa tshogs gnyis chu gter rdzogs pa'i sprin chen dang*/ bka' drin che ldan bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba bcas/ kun 28 bzang bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i zla ba/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan/ nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don nor bu'i phreng ba/

rnal 36 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i rtogs brjod las 'phros pa'i bstod pa ut+pa la'i phreng ba/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i bsrung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ lam zab bla ma brgyud pa'i brgyud rim kha skong*/ rgyud gsum bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong*/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar spros med kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong*/ kun rig dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong*/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong*/ tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong*/ rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong*/ dmar khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i kha skong*/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe khrid kyi gsol 'debs/ rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i kha skong*/ dpal khro chu sman sdong gi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje

42 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa snyan dngags chu gter spyod pa'i rlabs phreng*/ skyabs mchog bla ma rnams la bstod pa mtshan spel ut+pal phreng ba/ bka' drin che ldan bla ma rnams la bstod pa ut+pal phreng ba/ 'ja 51 ma mgon bkra shis lhun grub rang gis mdzad pa'i bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug skad gnyis shan sbyar byas pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub la bstod pa byin rlabs zla gzugs 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang nam mkha' bsam 'grub la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la bsngags pa rin chen rgyud mangs/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin la bstod pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu char 'bebs/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dbang phyug la bstod pa bkra shis g.yas 'khyil/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang bkra shis bzang po la bsngags pa byin rlabs sbrang rtsi len pa'i mgrin rnga/ yang mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong zhal snga nas zhabs brtan sh+lau ka gcig mdzad pa'i kha 'gengs bcas/ dpal ldan chos skyong la bstod pa byin rlabs nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta/ bla ma kun dga' dpal 'byor la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i rdzing bu/ sa skya pa ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' blo gros la bsngags pa sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan/ dpal ldan bla ma karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal la bsngags pa bsod nams dpag bsam/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang la bsngags pa byin rlabs rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sangs rgyas ye shes la bsngags pa ye shes gzigs pa 'gugs pa'i gling bu/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang la bstod pa dge legs dbyar dus 'gugs pa'i pho nya/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong tshul rin rang nyid bcas la bsngags pa me tog gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan/

skyabs mchog bkra shis lhun grub dang sangs rgyas bstan pa/ rnam gnyis la bstod pa 'dod don kun 'grub/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bstod pa dpyod ldan rna bar 'jebs pa'i gling bu/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rnam rgyal la bsngags pa dad pa'i chu 'phel zla ba/ mkhas btsun chos kyi rje bsod nams blo gros par bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod pa 'jo ba/ rab 'byams pa dge 'dun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la bstod pa yon tan ut+pal btus pa'i phreng ba/ ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang par bsngags pa byin rlabs dbyig gter 'dren pa'i shing rta/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa blo bzang dpal bzang par bsngags pa dbyangs can rgyud mangs/ grub dbang pad+ma nor bu la bstod pa ut+pal phreng mdzes/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la bstod pa 13 dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas/ rdzogs chen theg mchog sprul sku myur byon gyi gsol 'debs zla gzhon 'dren pa'i pho nya/ yang rdzogs chen sprul sku theg mchog bstan 'dzin pa'i sku gdung la mchod 'bul yan lag bdun pa/ mchog sprul blo bzang rnam rgyal la bsngags pa bskal bzang gzhon nu'i dga' ston/ chos smra 47 ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen can rang nyid la bsngags pa gus ldan ku mud dga' ba'i zla zer dang*/ mos ldan mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan phreng*/ yang rang la bsngags pa tshan gcig rmi lam du bskul ba po'i ngor bsngags pa tshan gnyis dang*/ ming spel me tog phreng ba/ yang dpal chos pa dang rang nyid bcas la gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyal ba ma pham pa dang rje dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis su med pa la bstod kyin gsol ba 'debs pa thugs rjer bskul ba'i rgyang glu/ yang rje dpal chos pa dang rang nyid la bstod gsol don gnyer mgul rgyan/ dpal chos par gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs tshan gcig dang brtan bzhugs me tog dkar po'i mchod sprin/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas la bsngags pa yid 'phrog rgyags pa'i glu dbyangs/

thang sgam sprul skur brtan bzhugs shis brjod/ bcom ldan 74 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la brten pa'i sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga dbang bcu grub pa'i bcud len/ sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo brten pa'i sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga nyi bu'i bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra/ sgra 87 dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can la bsngags pa don rgyan pad+ma dkar po bzhad pa'i rdzing bu/ kye 92 rdor lam dus kyi dbang chu bskur skabs kyi bdag 'jug dbang chog gi zur rgyan/ rdo rje gu 98 ra mkha' 'gro lnga ris bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor dbyangs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i mdun bskyed kyi ngag 'don gyi gsal byed/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi mngon rtogs la nye bar mkho ba'i tho chung*/ dpal 136 rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor dbyar gyi rnga gsang zhes bya 27 ba/ dpal 165 dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i gong du spro bar 'os pa'i chos byung gi gleng ba ko ki la'i dbyangs snyan/ slob ma rjes gzung gi cho ga rnam gsal shel gyi me long*/ sa bzung ba'i cho ga nyung ngu don tshang bcas/ dpal 187 dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bshad pa 'chi ba med pa'i rnga sgra/ dus 258 kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong ma gong chen bdag po'i dbang du bcas pa len pa'i cho ga yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas/ dpal 280 phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa rnam gsal nyi ma/ phyag 302 na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sreg blugs kyi cho ga dngos grub skyes bzang 'dren pa'i shing rta/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mar me'i sreg blugs kyi ngag 'don nyung ngu rab gsal bcas/

lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ma nor rab gsal dang*/ zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po la brten pa'i tshe sgrub kyi nyams len zla ba'i zil mngar/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge gu ru drag po mnga' bdag nyang lugs kyi las byang pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan dang*/ de'i bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs 'dod don kun stsol/ gu ru 320 drag dmar gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu don 'dus/ grub 323 pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi gsang spyod mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga las bzhi rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba rdzogs yan chad la sum brgya so gsum yod do// ༈ /glegs bam bzhi pa nga rtags can la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sgrub thabs skal ldan shing rta/ dkyil chog 65 skal ldan shing rta/ dpal 77 ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge yid ches lung gi rgyud mangs/ gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi shugs 'byung tshe ldan sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga'i zur rgyan/ kun rig sbyin sreg skabs kyi gsal byed gsar bu 'jug bde/ bcom ldan 81 'das rdo rje tshe'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i tho yig bkra shis 'od 'bar/ mtshan 91 yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs rin po che'i them skas/ 'jam dpal ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub nyams su len tshul/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab 'od brgya/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs bcad nyung ngu*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi spyod pa rjes su sgrub pa'i smon lam 'jam dpal dgyes par bskyed pa'i glu dbyangs/

'jam 104 dpal dkar po ma ti lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul lag len rnam gsal/ de'i rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bsngo smon bde ldan 'gugs pa'i pho nya bcas/ thugs 108 rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang*/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang thugs rje'i chu rgyun/ tsha gsur gyi cho ga dpag bsam yal 'dab/ spyan 114 ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid ngag 'don nyung ngu don tshang*/ thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa bde ldan 'dren pa'i theg pa/ tshem bu lugs kyi sgrub thabs nyung 'dus/ dmar khrid tshem bu lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ grub chen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge 'jam dpal gzhon nu la bstod gsol nyung ngu sbrang rtsi'i mgrin rnga/ thugs 123 rje chen po'i dmar khrid nges don dpyid kyi thig le 'chad par byed pa'i zur rgyan/ dge 137 slong dpal mo lugs kyi thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs smyung gnas dang bcas pa'i cho ga sdig sgrib rnam sbyong*/ smyung 158 bar gnas pa'i cho ga rnam gsal me long*/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'dren pa'i shing rta/ slob 266 dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga mkhas pa'i zhal lung dang brgyud pa bcas/ bcom ldan 172 'das tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga dal rten ring 'tshor sgrub pa'i bcud len/ sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs kyi gdams pa'i gsal byed yid ches sum ldan/

grub 193 chen thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe rta zung 'brel gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga tshe srog rdo rjer sgrub pa'i bcud len/ thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi rgyun 'khyer ring 'tsho tshe'i zil dngar/ byang gter lugs kyi tshe dpag med nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs/ mgon 220 dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i gter bum sgrub pa'i man ngag rnam gsal me long*/ mgon 233 dkar bskang ba yongs 'du sa brtol/ rta 239 mgrin yang phyung nag po'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur gyi cho ga rab dwangs me long*/ rta 247 mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen thabs yi ge'i rnga gsang*/ rdo rje rnam 254 par 'joms pa'i las bzhi'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khyad par ha nu man+tha dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge gdong can ma'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga ye shes me lce/ gser chos kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul nyung ngu rnam gsal/ rje 271 btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i mchod chog phrin las zla 'od gsar pa'i pho nya/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can la bstod pa mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra/ gser 265 chos mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi tshogs 'khor bya tshul bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ gser 290 chos lugs kyi seng ge'i gdong can sngon mo'i gtor bzlog gi phrin las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi tshogs mchod dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba yan chad la sum brgya 316 bcu drug yod do// ༈ /glegs bam lnga pa ca rtags can la/ dbu 1 ma lugs kyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga theg chen grong mchog 'jug pa'i shing rta/

de 26 bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ khro bo 70 gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang byad 'grol dang bcas pa'i lag len rnam gsal me long*/ snar thang 77 brgya rtsa las 'byung ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa'i yi ge 'dod 'jo'i ba mo/ 106 dpal snar thang pa'i lugs kyi seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ rje btsun 108 sgrol ma'i bstod pa phyag 'tshal nyer gcig la brten pa'i bstod sgrub shel gyi pi wang*/ dbang 111 dang rjes gnang la sogs pa'i gong du gleng bar 'os pa'i chos gtam dbyar gyi rnga gsang*/ bka' srung 121 tshogs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu don 'dus/ dmag 124 zor rgyal mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga nyams su blangs bde/ srung ma spyi'i bskang ba dngos grub rgya mtsho/ mgon po'i bshags 128 bzlas kyi skabs su mkho ba'i tho chung bstan srung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ gur 129 gyi mgon po'i sku rten thun mong ma yin pa'i rab gnas zhag bdun mar grags pa'i cho ga dmigs rim bcas pa'i ngag 'don bstan srung dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra/ thod pa sgrub pa'i ngag 'don dngos grub 'byung gnas/ dpal 133 dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub gsal bar byed pa'i gtam gyi rgyud mangs/ dpal 142 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog gi phrin las la nye bar mkho ba'i rol tshigs rnams kyi ring thung sogs kyi tho chung dran pa 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu/ ngor lugs bskang gso che chung rol tshigs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi zhal shes tho yig dran gso'i me long*/ drug cu pa'i 148 gtor bzlog sogs kyi dmod bcol mgo 'dren sbyor rgyu/ 150 rten 'brel zab mo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rnam gsal sgron ma/

grub dbang khyung po rnal 'byor pa las brgyud pa'i zab chos bzlas brjod smon pa 'grub pa'i pho nya dang las bzhi'i phrin las dang mthun pa'i 'dod don gsol ba/ dzam+bha 156 la dkar po phyi chu sbyin la brten nas bsgrub pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i rdzing bu/ nang gtor ma la brten nas bsgrub pa 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta/ gsang ba ga'u la brten nas bsgrub pa rin po che dbang gi rgyal po/ chos 166 spyod gtor ma'i rim pa kun dga'i rol mtsho/ sāts+tsha 171 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba/ skra dang sen mo sreg pa'i cho ga bde legs nyi ma/ gzungs 'bul gyi lag len nyung gsal/ legs 182 par sbyar ba'i skad kyi klog thabs rnam gsal sgron ma/ dgon sde rnams 187 kyi bslab bya'i bca' yig legs nyes rang zhal snang ba'i me long*/ sgrol ma 201 dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs las brtsams pa'i dris lan pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ drin lan me tog phreng ba/ drin lan bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad nyung 'dus/ nyams su bstar bya gdams ngag rkang pa drug pa'i glu chung*/ kun rig lho sgo'i skabs kyi dogs gnas sel byed/ kun rig sogs rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor thig tshon gyis 'dri ba'i cho ga rnam gsal me long*/ mchod yul rnams la phud mchod nyung ngu*/ dogs

217 pa'i gnas kyi mdud bu 'grol ba'i drin lan sor mo'i zlos gar/ kun rig la brten pa'i sa chog mdor bsdus/ sa paṇa zhal btang ba'i 'dra chos brag cha'i sgra dbyangs/ phywa phreng 281 nor bu mchog rgyal gyi g.yang skyob cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ bla ma 261 rgyal ba sras bcas bstan srung nor lha rnams la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba gsol gdab sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas gsar bskrun rnams kyi dkar chag bsngo ba smon lam bsdoms pa phun tshogs sde bzhi'i bang mdzod ces bya ba la le tshan brgyad cu gya drug yod pa yan chad la sum brgya bcu gcig yod do// ༈ /glegs bam drug pa cha rtags can la mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa la bsngags pa ka phreng mu tig do shal/ rdo rje 3 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang bskur gyi mtshams sbyor bshad pa bkra shis 'khyil pa'i dbyangs snyan/ kun rig 34 la brten pa'i gshin po'i rus sbyong dang sāts+tsha sgrub pa'i ngag 'don ut+pal mgul rgyan/ kun rig cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi 'don 'grigs nyer mkho gzhan phan zur rgyan/ rab gnas 47 dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i 'don brjod la nye bar mkho ba'i zur rgyan mtshar sdug 'gram chang*/ rten gsar rnying la bya ba ar+gha'i cho ga mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ gur 64 gyi mgon po phyi srung ba'i 'khor lo dang nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor khyad par ba'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i go mtshon dang rgyun 'khyer nyung ngu rnam gsal bcas/ gur 77 mgon khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor 'dri thabs rab gnas dang bcas pa'i cho ga rnam gsal rin chen sgron ma/ gur mgon dang bir+wa pa'i thog srung lag len bsnyengs bral rdo rje'i go khrab/ dpal 84 mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa'i gsang khrid kyi sgrub thabs 'dzam bu'i snye ma/ dge 91 ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub snying po'i khams su bsngo ba'i yon bshad dang bcas pa'i brjod pa yongs 'du'i snye ma dang*/

bsngo ba'i ngag 'don 'gro drug thar pa 'khrid pa'i pho nya/ rten la phyag mchod 'bul ba'i 'don bya dge legs mtsho 'phel/ rgyal chen 106 rnam thos bu'i sku brnyan bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i bka' lan tshangs sras rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i dbyangs chung*/ yang 123 de las brtsams pa'i bka' lung gi dri ba'i bka' lan mtsho byung lus phra'i glu dbyangs/ gsung lan dogs gnas 'bigs pa'i nyag phran/ skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa'i bka' lan mi 'gyur phreng ba'i gad mo/ gsung 144 lan dogs pa'i rnyog ma bgrung ba'i nor bu/ nyams su blang byar gdams pa'i bdud rtsi gsol 'debs snye ma bsu ba'i dbyar gyi dpal mo/ dge tshogs byang chub snying po'i rgyur smin pa'i bsngo smon byang chub spyod pa'i gser 'gyur/ gnyer pa a zlos kyis grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i bris sku dang bcu gcig zhal thang bzhengs pa'i zhal byang smon lam nyung ngu*/ dga' 153 ldan rnam rgyal gling du rten bzhengs kyi gleng ba dbyar gyi rnga gsang*/ lhun 166 grub steng srib dgon gyi gtsug lag khang du bskang gso rtag 'don gyi gtan 'jog gi yi ge mi 'gyur tshangs pa'i drang thig chos sde'i spyi rdzas gtan 'jog rnams kyi deb yig tshogs gsum mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bzhad sgra/ dgon gsar dga' ldan chos 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang steng du gser zangs las grub pa'i 'gan ji ra bzhi ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba dkar chag shel gyi me long*/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gi zhal byang bsngo ba smon lam nyung ngu bcas/ bsngags 178 'os dam pa rnams la legs 'bul stob pa'i gong brjod kyi tshigs bcad dpyod ldan kun dga'i dbyangs snyan/ mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan par khri 'bul legs mtshon stob pa'i gong brjod rang gis bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho sku mched kyis mkhan chen g.yar 'dren zhus pa legs 'bul gong brjod/

mkhan chen pa o rgyan don grub sku mched sdum par spyan drangs pa'i legs 'bul gong brjod/ par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin gyis sdum par mkhan chen spyan drangs pa'i legs 'bul gong brjod/ bkra shis ltem du sa dbang gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su klu sdings pa spyan drangs pa'i bsngo rten 'bul chen gyi gong brjod rab 'byams mchod yul dgyes pa'i sprin gyi bzhad sgra/ yang si tu sprul pa'i skur sa dbang gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub pa'i 'bul chen gyi gong brjod rnam par dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i rol mtsho/ a dran bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dus yol dge rdzong du shar chen pa spyan drangs pa'i 'bul tshan gong brjod/ lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang du mkhan chen shar par khri 'bul bzhag dus kyi bkod pa'i yi ge sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por phul ba'i zhu yig ri dwags gzugs can/ po ṭa lar rgyal tshab de mo sprul skur 'bul ba'i gong brjod snyan dngags rkang drug glu dbyangs/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul skur 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig bung ba'i dbyangs chung*/ dbon rin chen mchog grub pas sde dge sa skyong bla ma lcam dral bcas la gang ci'i mgo 'dren mi chung gsol ba'i zhu yig dbon rin chen mchog grub dbus su bteg pa'i snyan sgron 'bul ba'i zhu yig khams bzang gsol ba'i gong brjod rnams so// shar chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid tshogs dbur spyan drangs thob pa'i legs gsol gyi 'bul yig bh+ra ma ra'i mgrin rnga dang*/ yang de nyid tshogs dbur spyan drangs nas dpal spungs dbon po bsam gtan pa'i ngor bris pa dang*/ rdzogs chen rin po che'i yang srid sprul sku'i khri 'bul sa skyong bla ma dang rang gis 'bul ba'i gong brjod tshan gnyis/ gnyer tshul khrims dbang phyug pas shar chen pa spyan drangs pa'i 'bul yig

gnyer tshul khrims rab brtan pas klu sdings mkhan chen spyan drangs pa'i 'bul tho/ sangs rgyas bzang po pas mkhan chen spyan drangs pa'i 'bul tho/ gtsang paṇa chen sprul skur 'bul ba'i gong brjod snyan dngags chu gter g.yo ba'i rlabs phreng*/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par 'bul rgyu'i zhu 'phrin snyan dngags gzhan gsos bu mo'i gdangs snyan/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid sprul skur 'bul tshan gyi snyan dngags dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ de mo sprul skur 'bul rgyu'i yi ge bh+ra ma ra'i mgrin snyan/ rtse gdong sprul pa'i sku rin po che bstan 'dzin lhun grub par dbul bya'i snyan dngags ngur mo'i mgrin pa'i rdza rnga/ e waṃ khri thogs pa mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog grags par 'bul rgyu'i snyan dngags tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rol mo/ e waṃ khang gsar chos skyong bzang por dbul bya snyan dngags yon tan rin chen 'dren pa'i nā di/ e waṃ thar pa rtser 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig gzhan bsos glu dbyangs/ khar kha'i rje btsun dam par 'bul ba'i zhu yig snyan dngags sin+dhu'i rlabs phreng*/ zla ba gzas 'dzin gyi dge bskul yi ge dri za'i sgra snyan/ ka sogs 'bru rkyang 'dogs 'brel brtsegs pa log sde rnams 'dri ba'i dpe rnams dang bcas/ gser chos 230 lugs kyi dmar po skor gsum bsang mchod cho ga sde bzhi'i dga' ston 'jo ba'i dbyar ring*/ lha bsang 'khyer bde mgron rigs dgyes pa'i rol mtsho/ bdag chen rgya gar pas mdzad pa'i spyi bsang dang skye ba lnga pa sbrags pa'i 'don 'grigs kyi tho chung*/ spyi 236 bsang gi cho ga skye ba lnga pa'i sgra dbyangs/ bsang mchod bsdus pa bde legs nyi ma/ kye rdo rje rgyud gsum lha tshogs srung mar bcas pa'i bsang tshul rdo rje glu ma'i dbyangs mchod/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsang mchod/

lha mo 'od zer can ma'i bsang mchod bde legs dpal ster/ seng ge'i gdong can bsang mchod cho ga ḍā ki dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bsang mchod dga' ston gzhon nu/ bsngo ba mdor bsdus bcas/ gur 253 mgon 'khor dang bcas pas mtshon pa'i srung ma rnams kyi bsang mchod bdud las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra/ mgon dkar bsang mchod 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ dur khrod bdag po'i bsang mchod sprin gyi bzhad sgra/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod cho ga sprin gyi rnga chen/ dpal ldan lha mo sngags srung drag mo'i bsang dang mnga' gsol/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bsang mchod sprin gyi rnga gsang*/ dzam+bha la dmar po'i bsang mchod cho ga rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs snyan/ rta lha'i bsang mchod khu byug dga' ma myos pa'i mgrin glu/ klu'i bsang mchod cho ga gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter/ zhing lha chen po 'khor bcas mchod pa'i cho ga rdzogs ldan sprin phung*/ bstan 278 srung beg tse lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi yi ge bsam don ltad mor rtsen pa'i nyi ma/ mdo khams yul gru 'ga' zhig gi gzhi bdag bsang mchod kyi skor las/ gser dang ldan ma'i yul gyi gzhi bdag 'bar lha rtse rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i dga' ston/ bong sna'i dge bsnyen dar mdung dkar po can 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod cho ga dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs/ dge bsnyen mched lcam 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod cho ga shis pa g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs/ ldan yul ska phu'i gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu/ brag dkar dung 'dra'i lha mo mched gsum la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga rin chen rgyud mangs/ gsing lha ngom gsal 'khor dang bcas par bsang mchod stob pa'i cho ga bkra shis dbyangs snyan/ a mye smug mdzangs can gyi bsang mchod yul bdag dgyes pa'i rol mtsho/

rab bkram brag dkar stag rtse mched 'khor bcas pa'i bsang mchod sprin gyi bzhad sgra/ mdo smad dngul chu'i rgyud kyi gzhi bdag khams 'phags gnam mchongs dang dar seng 'brug rgyal sogs yul lha 'khor bcas la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga bkra shis char 'bebs/ mdo smad ljongs kyi gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba'i zo dor rgyal po khro zil phram rdo rje g.yung drung 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod cho ga dge legs char 'bebs/ 'bri klung dal 'bab 'gram gyi gzhi bdag jo bo bag seng gnyen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod cho ga legs bris dpal gyi dga' ston zhes bya ba rnams dang*/ yul 308 ris gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma stob pa'i cho ga yul bdag dgyes pa'i rol mtsho/ srid pa'i lha 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs la bsgo ba'i chos gtam bdud rtsi'i dga' ston/ 'jig rten lha 'dre'i tshogs la chos min spong ba'i 'phrin yig srid zhi'i khyab bdag snyems pa'i bzhad sgra/ srid pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs la bsgo ba'i 'phrin yig gdong lnga'i nga ro zhes bya ba yan chad sum brgya bcu gnyis yod do// ༈ /glegs bam bdun pa ja rtags can la ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros par bstod pa bsam dgu'i sbrang rtsi len pa'i mgrin snyan/ yang de nyid la bsngags brjod bung ba'i mgrin snyan/ skyabs yul rnam lngar bstod gsol mu tig mgul rgyan/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor ngag 'don skal ba bzang po'i mgul rgyan/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi brgyud par gsol 'debs/ thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs gtsor smos bla ma yi dam kun 'dus la gsol ba 'debs pa dkon mchog thugs rje bskul ba'i 'phrin yig nyal ba'i rnal 'byor mgon dkar rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub dbyig gter 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dod gsol nyung ngu*/ dpal 10 gshin rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs zhal lung 'dab brgya bye ba'i 'gram chang*/

gdong drug dbang gi brgyud pa/ dpal 15 gshin rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga smin byed 'dab brgya phye ba'i 'gram chang*/ gshin 62 rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug pa lha nyer gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor smin byed gser ldan 'degs pa'i 'jug pa/ tshe dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba'i gsal byed som nyi'i mun 'phrog de'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs/ thang 404 stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe sgrub nyams su len tshul 'chi med bcud len/ gser chos 'jam 105 dpal nag po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang tshul kun dga'i me long*/ de'i rjes gnang bya tshul kun dga'i me long*/ seng ge'i gdong can ma'i sgrub thabs nyung 'dus bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra/ gnyen sgrol 114 yan lag drug pa'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gyi yi ge ut+pal gzhon nu'i phreng ba/ phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge nyung gsal/ dzam+bha la dmar po ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa ci 'dod gter gyi bum bzang*/ gu ru 123 drag dmar me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang cho ga rnam gsal me long*/ yang de'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad can/ rje btsun 132 seng ge sgra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i cho ga zla 'od gsar pa/ bstan 137 srung dbang po rnams thugs dgyes par bskyed pa dang dgra bgegs la rbad pa'i tshul du sgrub pa'i phrin las gtor bzlog g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i nga ro/ bstan pa'i gegs sel gtor bzlog rnams kyi dmod bcol mgo 'dren dpyod ldan dga' byed/ lhag 157 pa'i lha bka' sdod du bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga nyung ngu don 'dus/ bstan 162 srung rnams la rkyen sel phrin 'chol re ba myur 'gengs/ 'dod gsol don yod zhags pa/

kye rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gsal ba'i me long mdzes par byed pa'i zur rgyan/ las kyi gshin rje'i bsnyen thabs kyi tho zur/ las kyi gshin rje'i 'khor lo 'dri ba'i tho chung*/ dga' ldan pa'i gtor chen skabs kyi gsal byed/ grwa pa mngon shes pa'i lugs kyi dzam+bha la dmar po chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa'i tshul 'dod 'jo'i dpag bsam/ sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs nyung ngu*/ 'dod gsol nyung ngu*/ bstan 177 srung dbang po'i tshogs la phrin las bskul ba 'jigs rung rdo rje'i bzhad sgra/ bstan pa cher rgyas kyi 'dod gsol bkra shis dbyangs snyan/ bka' srung rnams la phrin las bskul pa brtsams don 'grub pa'i pho nya/ bka' srung gnyen po rnams kyi thugs dam rgyud nas bskul ba'i tshigs bcad bstan srung dgyes pa'i rnga sgra/ bstan srung dbang po rnams la las bcol bstan dgra'i snying dmar 'byin pa'i bzhad sgra/ lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma la bstod pa/ mgon 177 khang shar nub gnyis su bstan srung rnams la bskang gso dang spyan gzigs 'bul ba'i las bskul bstan pa rgyas pa'i dbyar rnga/ bstan srung tshogs la gegs sel phrin las bskul ba'i pho nya/ bstan srung rnams la bskang gso 'dod don gsol ba'i rkang mgyogs/ mgon khang chen por kun dga' rgya mtsho 'da' ka ma'i smon lam 'grub pa'i grogs bcol gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon dgar bzhugs pa'i thub chen sku mdun la mchod 'bul bung ba'i mgrin glu/ rdo rje 'chang kun dag bzang po'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan la mchod 'bul gyi tshe 'dod gsol/ mchod sdong srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam chen por yan lag bdun pa'i mchod 'bul dri za'i dbyangs snyan/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku brnyan la 'dod gsol dad pa'i rdza rnga/ gtsug lag khang du brgya mchod dang gan gos kyi 'phan bcas phul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dge legs g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs/

bstan srung tshogs la rkyen sel bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra/ don gnyer gyi ngor 'dod gsol nyung ngu*/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du gos 'phan yan lag bdun pa bcas phul ba bsod nams sprin chen/ lhun grub steng gi chos dung zung la bsngags pa bshad sgrub rgyas glu/ rten

187 bzhengs rnams kyi zhal byang dang bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i sbrang rtsi'i yol go zhes bya ba'i nang du dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sku brnyan gyi bris sku'i bsngo byang*/ mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i skye phreng bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang*/ mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i sngon rabs skye phreng dang bcas pa'i gzugs bkod kyi phyi mo zhal byang*/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas pa'i sku brnyan gtso 'khor gyi bris sku bzhengs pa'i zhal byang bsngo ba nyung shas/ gnas gsar zhabs drung rin po che'i spur ras la 'dod lha bris pa'i zhal byang*/ sangs rgyas so lnga'i bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang*/ sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga'i bsngo byang*/ thub dbang gtsor byas kyi bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang*/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la phrin las sgrol ma nyer gcig gis bskor ba'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang*/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sku brnyan zhal thang bzhengs pa'i 'dod gsol/ dgongs 'dus bris sku bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang*/ bka' brgyad bris sku'i bsngo byang*/ dpal chos pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang*/ ral gri rin chen dpal sa skya'i bse 'bag gi spyan gzigs phul ba'i kha byang*/ dpal ldan lha mor rkyen sel 'dod gsol/ lhun grub steng gi tshogs zangs 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung zhes bya ba'i zhal byang*/ tshogs zangs dkon mchog mchod sprin zhes bya ba'i zhal byang*/ bcu 193 gcig zhal gyi bsnyen thabs dri med phreng ba'i gsal byed/ dam 196 pa'i chos sgrogs byed pa'i sngon rjes kyi bsam brjod rnam gsal me long*/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i gsol 'debs 'dod don grub pa'i pho nya/ chos 201 gtam thar par 'khrid pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'chi kha bar do'i 'gro ba rnams la gdams pa/

rgyun gyi smon lam bsam don 'grub pa'i rkang mgyogs/ gsang 212 chen rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams nas bstan pa'i gnas yul chen po rnams kyi ngos 'dzin shes bya'i ltad mo ngom pa'i me long*/ dgos 227 skabs chos kyi dka' gnas kyi dogs pa 'dri ba'i lan ldon me tog phreng ba/ nyams len skabs kyi dogs gnas dri ba 'ga' zhig byung ba'i lan ldon kun phan gzhon nu/ sprul 246 pa'i sku mchog skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa nas bka'i 'phrin yig ma bu 'byor ba'i gsung lan a mra'i 'bras bu/ zab mo'i don las brtsams pa'i gdams pa thar mchog bdud rtsi'i bcud len/ mtshan med rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tho chung*/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i rtsa sngags kyi spel tshig las brtsams pa'i gsung lan rin chen snang gsal/ sangs rgyas bzang pos gan+dho la'i gtsug lag khang du ral gri phul ba'i 'dod gsol/ shes bya'i gnas 257 kyi dogs pa dris pa'i lan ldon yid 'phrog rkang stabs/ bsang 272 mchod kyi cho ga'i rnam par bshad pa tshogs gnyis chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba/ rigs 297 gsum mgon po'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa/ nyams su blang bya'i gdams pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud len/ mngon 'dod lam dang mthun pa'i smon lam don yod zhags pa/ dgos skabs kyi 'dod gsol/ sprul 34 pa'i rgyal po chen po bse khrab pa'i thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga rdzogs ldan sprin gyi rnga gsang*/ rgyal chen bse khrab par gtor ma'i cho ga bka' sdod dregs pa dgyes pa'i dga' ston/ tho'am sgo 'gram lta bur 'dri bar 'os pa/ 'jigs 313 byed drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog skabs kyi drag bskul dus dgra'i dbang po bzhad pa'i nga ro/ bstan srung 317 rnams la phrin las bskul ba 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta/ snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol nyung ngu*/ gnod sbyin 319 dgra bla'i rgyal po ya ba rkya bdun la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga lha'i rnga chen khyon bsdoms sum brgya nyer gnyis byon//

༈ /glegs bam nya rtags can la/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po dang chos smra ba'i slob dpon shī la rat+nar bod pa dbyer med du bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa tshangs sras 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ slob dpon pad+mā kā ra la gsol ba 'debs pa nyung ngu bsam don kun 'grub/ gser chos lugs kyi seng gdong ma'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa dang e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs stabs cig pa'i gsol 'debs/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa mtshan spel bkra shis dbyangs snyan/ mkhan chen dkon mchog grags pa'i rgyal mtshan pa la bsngags pa/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po par bstod pa bsod nams gru chen/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho par bsngags pa byin rlabs gaṅgā'i klung 'jo/ yul mchog gyur rnams la skabs su 'gro zhing 'dod don sbrang rtsi len pa'i dbyangs chung*/ skyabs gsum dbyer med gsol 'debs nyung bsdus/ tshul khrims 11 rin chen rang la bsngags brjod zla snang 'bab stegs/ rang la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod pa'i dpal 'jo/ ring 'tsho dang gsol 'debs don yod zhags pa/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang bzang po bkra shis par bsngags brjod me tog 'phyang 'phrul/ chos rje rin chen lhun grub par bsngags brjod dge legs 'byung sgo/ rab 'byams sangs rgyas bzang po la bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i gling bu/ dus 'khor bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs pa la bsngags pa dad dga' rgyas pa'i mgrin glu/ rang bstod blo gsal me long*/ zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bkra shis dbyangs snyan/ rigs gsum mgon la yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa bsam don lhun grub/ ring 'tsho'i gsol 'debs rga shi med pa'i bcud len/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha 'gengs/

ze chen sprul pa'i sku pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa'i gzugs sku'i bkod pa brtul ba'i skabs su sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs dgos don nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta/ rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor rnam gsal nyi ma/ 'phags 51 pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gaṅgā'i klung chen/ gu ru 92 pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi bsreg blugs kyi cho ga nyes skyon mun stug zla ba'i gsal sgron/ bkra shis mdor bsdus/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sbyin sreg cho ga me lha dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ bsngo ba smon lam mdor bsdus/ skyer 107 sgang nas brgyud pa'i rta mchog rol pa'i sgrub thabs yid ches pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan/ khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal kun dga'i me long*/ rdo rje gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer nyung ngu rnam gsal/ sgrol ma 130 dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge zla 'od gsar pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub bsnyen pa'i dmigs bsal som nyi'i mdud bu 'grol byed/ phyag 129 na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i ngag 'don gyi tho chung rin chen sgron ma/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol 'debs/ 'chi 'joms dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ mkha' 138 spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam rnam 'grel 'dab stong 'grol ba'i kha chang*/ zab don gdams pa'i sbrang rtsi'i thig pa/ 'byung 160 ba lnga'i tsha tsha bskrun pa'i mchod sbyin la brten pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga grub pa'i zhal lung 'dab brgya 'grol byed/

kha 170 'bar ma dkar mo la brtan nas 'chi ba bslu zhing bar gcod bzlog pa'i thabs 'chi med bde ster/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i gdams pa ches zab ring 'tsho'i dpal ster/ thugs 175 rje chen po'i dmar khrid lam gyi yon tan skye 'gyur smon lam mngon 'dod mdza' na 'gugs pa'i phrin snyan/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'dod don smon lam bde legs mdza' bo 'gugs pa'i pho nya/ ye shes pa dang 'jigs rten pa'i mchod yul rnams la 'bod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i yi ge srid zhi'i gzugs brgya 'char ba'i me long*/ 'gro 'ong sdod pa'i skabs kyi gegs sel legs smon/ dgon sde 184 gsar 'debs sogs kyi tshe khyad chos sbyar bar 'os pa'i zur rgyan mal+li ka'i phreng ba/ rten bzhengs rnams kyi gzungs 'bul mthar 'dod don gsol gdab dmigs bsal bstan 'gro'i dge legs 'phel byed/ lha 190 rgyal srang gi chos sde srid gsum yongs 'du'i dge 'dun gyis mtshon pa'i dgon sde spyi'i bslab bya rags bsdus gzur gnas tshangs pa'i drangs thig lha 203 rgyal srang gi chos sde srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs/ byang 234 chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs pa'i bzhugs byang dkar chag tshogs gnyis khang bzang bgrod pa'i them skas/ rin chen gser sbyangs khams las grub pa'i yi ger bzhengs pa'i dge tshogs byang chub tu smin pa'i bsngo byang smon lam rnam grol 'jug pa'i them skas/ sgom chen pa'i smras lan rtse 'jo'i tshul du bris pa/ yid lhung 242 lha rgyal srang gi gtsug lag khang gi srid gsum dge legs yongs 'du zhes bya ba'i phyi nang gi gtan 'jog dngos po'i deb ther rang gzhan yid ches skyid pa'i bden dpang*/ mkha' 244 spyod yum la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam/

dpal sa skya'i gser chos lugs kyi nā ro mkha' spyod la brten pa'i 'pho ba 'od gsal bar dor bcas pa'i nyams len zab gnad btus pa'i bdud rtsi/ gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i zeg ma/ dri'i gtsang 254 khang gi thub chen yid bzhin nor bu la gegs sel 'dod gsol/ e waṃ pa chen po'i sku brnyan la gnas skabs 'dod gsol/ thub chen sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan la mchod 'bul gyi bsngo ba smon lam/ rang gi mchod 'bul gyi tshe bris pa'i 'dod gsol/ e waṃ gtsug lag khang gi dar 'phan yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad/ bstan srung tshogs la snyan shal phul ba'i 'dod gsol/ mgon khang nub tu kun dga' bsod nams pa mgon byar bkod tshe 'dod gsol nyung ngu*/ mchod sdong srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam la rkyen sel 'dod don gsol ba/ mgon khang nub shar du rkyen sel gyi 'dod gsol/ bstan srung dbang po rnams la rang gi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i las bcol don yod zhags pa/ gsang mgon yid bzhin nor bu la rang gi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i las bcol dpag bsam yongs 'du/ rkyen sel gyi tshe bstan srung dbang po rnams la snyan shal/ kun dga' blo gsal ngor bstan srung snyan shal/ bstan srung rnams la 'dod gsol rkang mgyogs grub pa'i pho nya/ 'dod gsol lha dbang rdo rje/ bstan srung dbang por las bskul bskal ba'i zhugs chen/ dgos skabs kyi las bcol bsam don 'gugs pa'i pho nya/ dpal ldan 264 sa skya'i gser chos lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs zab khrid myur lam rkang mgyogs sgrub pa'i gom stabs/ dogs 291 gnas 'ching rgya grol ba'i tho chung mchar sdug kha chang*/ mkhan 297 chen klu sdings par 'bul yig dang gzhan gyi ched du bris pa tshan gnyis/ dpal 301 sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par phul ba'i zhu yig gan+dharba'i glu ma/

yang de nyid sku zhabs su 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig snyan dngags 'dab brgya bzhad pa/ mkhan chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan par 'bul ba'i gong brjod chu skyes 'phyang 'phrul/ yang de nyid la kun dga' bsod nams kyi 'bul yig sangs rgyas bzang po sa skyar btegs pa'i skyes 'bul gyi yi ge sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan/ hor blo bzang smon lam par 'bul yig lha sras sa skyong chen po chos skyong mgon gnyan 'dong ri rtser byon skabs 'bul yig sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho lcam dral nas kun 'dzin gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston shing thog dang zas sna tshogs stsal skabs rang gzhan gyi ched du zhu yig tshan gnyis/ sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho par bsnyung sel 'bul yig sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho pa dang gzhung sa chen po jus nye bsgrigs pa'i legs gsol stob pa'i skabs 'bul yig tshan gnyis yan chad la sum brgya dang nyer bzhi yod do// ༈ /glegs bam dgu pa ta rtags can la/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs ngag 'don ba ku la'i kha 'byed/ bde 10 mchog sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor dbang chog ba ku la'i kha 'byed/ rdo rje mi 'khru 49 gas pa'i cho ga las sgrib rnam sbyong gi gshin gson rjes 'dzin skabs kyi zur rgyan som nyi'i mun sel sgrol ma/ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sgrub thabs/ gza' 64 yum 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga nad gdon mun pa sel ba'i ma zlum/ lo 77 thog sad srung mya ngan med pa'i kha 'byed/ rlung gnod gyi ngag 'don gsal sgron/ kye 89 rdo rje dang rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis la gtor 'bul 'bring bsdus cho ga khyer bde/ gtor chog dngos grub myur mgyogs/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi 'dod gsol nyung bsdus/ dur khrod bdag po'i sku la bri rgyu'i phrin 'chol tshan gnyis/ ma 94 gcig rdo rje dbang grol ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor bsngo dang thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga bsam don kun 'grub/

gtor bsngo 'bring po bsags lugs/ 'jam 99 dpal a ra pa tsa'i sgrub thabs nyin byed snang ba/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dung 'don ched du bris pa/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma bsdus pa bya tshul/ g.yang sgrub sogs kyi skabs bse rag bcings thabs/ 'byung 184 bzhi'i cho ga dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ bar do'i gtor ma cha lnga pa'i nyams su blang bde'i ngag 'don rin chen gsal sgron/ thub 113 pa gnas brtan 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi rim pa rdzogs ldan bsod nams sprin phung*/ nyag 116 brag yul gyi gzhi bdag 'bung chung stag ril 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod 'dod 'byung sprin gyi rnga gsang*/ smad shod phyogs kyi zo dor mu nam nga 'dra 'khor du bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil pa'i dbyangs snyan/ dge 'dun 104 dbyen 'dum gyi mchod rten chen po bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dwangs shel me long*/ bkod bzhag smras don khur len 'dzol med dgos pa 'gyur med gtan tshigs rdo rje'i rgya mdzes/ rnam 130 par dpyod ldan nas som nyi'i gnas kyi gsung lan dbang po'i zla ris/ gtan 139 'jog gi yi ge 'gyur med drang thig dpal 155 lhun grub steng gi chos grwa dang rngo kho lha khang bcas par bskor ba'i grangs tshad bsod nams 'bum gzugs 'char ba'i me long*/ dam

163 pa'i chos sgrogs pa rnams la phan par gdams pa don gnyis grub pa'i bcud len/ bla 169 ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa la 'dod don gsol ba'i yi ge dge legs bsam don lhun grub/ dpal 203 sa skya'i gong ma rdo rje 'chang yab sras dang ngor khang gsar mkhan chen dang karma zhwa nag pa bcas la rang gzhan gyi legs 'bul stob pa'i shis brjod tshangs sras rgyud mangs sgra dbyangs/ nyi grags sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam dbang gi lcags kyu/ zhwa 215 ser bstan pa'i snang byed mchog gi sprul sku ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang par brda sprod kun bshad kyi mtshan gsol bi warta/ pad+ma kun grol zhing khams gshegs tshe sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs smon lam rkang mgyogs grub pa'i pho nya/ rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin phrin las dbang phyug a ti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par zhabs brtan smon gsol dbang bcu grub pa'i bcud len/ sprul sku gsang sngags bstan 'dzin par zhabs brtan smon lam dad ldan mgul rgyan/ karma bstan pa'i snang byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba zhes grags pa'i sprul sku myur 'byon gyi rgyud bskul dbang gi lcags kyu/ thub pa gnas brtan 'khor tshogs bcas la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba dang dgos skabs kyi 'dod gsol don gnyis 'grub pa'i pho nya/ chos rje kun dga' bsod nams pa la bsngags pa phan bde'i char 'jo/ thub pa gnas brtan 'khor bcas kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i bsngo byang tshogs zung chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba/ me 222 khyi'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rta pa'i zla tshes sgra gcan dus mes ri bong 'dzin par 'jug pa'i ri mo shar tshe sgo yig dge ba'i 'phrin shod/ sher snying bdud bzlog sogs kyi dpang gzu lha dbang rdo rje/ ston mchog gi 'dul ba lung bzhir bstan pa'i mthun po spun gsum gyi rtogs brjod/

ston 138 mchog nyi ma'i rtsa lag bstan skyong gnas brtan bcu drug zhabs 'bring dharma tā la mi bdag ha shang bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ rang 301 gi rtogs brjod thang kar bkod pa'i zhal byang don bsdu kun dga' bskyed pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho/ chos smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa'i skye ba phal pa'i rkang 'thung dge sdig 'dres ma'i las kyi yal ga phan tshun du 'dzings par bde sdug gi lo 'dab dus kyi rgyal mos re mos su bsgyur ba zhes bya ba yan chad la bzhi brgya dang nga brgyad yod do// ༈ /glegs bam bcu pa a rtags can la/ thams 1 cad mkhyen pa chen po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa mal+li kā'i phreng ba/ thub 30 pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod pa ut+pa la'i phreng ba/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'gram du 'dri bar 'os pa srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa kha byang bcas/ mi 34 mchog sras dang bcas pa'i mtshan mchog rin po che'i phreng ba/ ston 48 mchog gang las byon pa'i shākya rnams kyi sngon rabs gleng ba'i chos gtam dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin glu/ bka' 57 nye bar mkho ba rnams gcig tu bsdebs pa'i glegs bam 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i bum bzang*/ gtsug 62 lag khang chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng*/ mngon pa'i lugs kyi stong gsum 'jig rten khams kyi bkod pa ri mor 'dri tshul shes bya'i bzhin ras ston pa'i me long*/ mngon pa'i lugs kyi stong gsum mi mjed bkod pa'i ri mo'i kha byang*/ srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa'i bshad pa rgyu 'bras ston pa'i pho nya/ tshe ring rnam pa drug dang bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par bkod pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bshad pa/ chos 97 sde'i gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon/

de bzhin 153 gshegs pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi dkar chag ngo mtshar me long*/ dus kyi pho 157 nya gsar tshes kyi gnam lo'i byed grub rtsis kyi le'u tho bzang ngan gzugs brnyan ston pa'i me long*/ me yos kyi gnam lo rdzogs pa'i le'u tho dri med me long*/ chu sprel gyi gnam lo rdzogs pa'i le'u tho pad dkar rdzing bu/ rnga chen gyi gnam lo'i dgun zla rwa bar zla ba gza' 'dzin gyi ri mo shar ba'i sgo yig na tshod ldan gyi gnam lo'i spo zlar zla ba sgra gcan phrad pa'i 'phrin yig bstan bcos 170 'gyur ro tshal gyi chos sbyin rgyun mi chad pa'i phyi mo rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i bsod nams kyi sprin phung rgyas par dkrigs pa'i bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa dge legs yid gcugs mdza' na 'gugs pa'i rgyang glu/ mkhas 186 grub klong chen rab 'byams pa'i gsung rab las phyung ba'i bstan bcos kyi phyi mo bskrun pa'i par byang dang yongs su bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa bstan srid lang tsho bdo ba'i zil mdar/ nges don snying po'i par byang nyung ngu*/ gsung ngag rin po che'i par byang nyung ngu*/ kun rig gi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa'i par byang bsngo smon gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ gdugs dkar gzungs kyi par byang*/ le'u bdun pa'i bsngo byang*/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyis mtshon pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa la sogs pa'i bsngo smon dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i rgyang glu/ mdo sde bskal bzang dang rgyal yum stong phrag brgya pa bzhengs pa'i bsngo smon gyi tshigs su bcad pa bskal bzang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ bka' lung 'gyur ro 'tshal bsod nams kyi zhing du bsgrubs pa'i bsngo smon mdor bsdus/ bsngags 201 'os mchog 'bring gi yul rnams la zhu yig 'bul ba'i dper brjod blo gros gsar bu 'jug sgo/ zhing 210 khyad par 'phags pa'i skyabs yul kun 'dus bdag nyid rnams la phul ba'i bskur yig snyan dngags pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba las/

sa skya'i rje btsun ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang*/ mthu stobs dbang phyug sku mched kyi drung 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig rkang drug dbyangs chung*/ gtsang paṇa chen rin po che'i sku zhabs su 'bul bya'i zhu yig mtho ris ngang mo'i bzhad sgra/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po pa'i sku zhabs su phul ba'i zhu yig rdo rje glu ma'i dbyangs mchod/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku zhabs su 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig tshangs sras dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ byams pa bsod nams bzang po'i zhal sngar zhu yig 'dod yon dga' ma'i dbyangs mchod/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong spyan lam du 'bul tshan bshams pa'i tshe gleng ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng*/ skye dgu dgon gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs grub nas rab gnas kyi skabs su mchod 'bul gyi gleng brjod me tog phreng ba/ rgyal tshab dpal ldan chos skyong la khri 'bul gyi skabs su mchod brjod las brtsams pa'i snyan 'bul gyi gleng bslang me tog sil ma/ dpal ldan chos skyong sku zhabs su 'bul tshan gyi blar sbyar rgyu'i tshigs bcad/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong dpal bzang po pa rab gnas tshogs dbur spyan drangs te dga' ston stob pa'i mchod brjod bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbyangs snyan/ dpal ldan chos skyong gtsang dbus phyogs su chibs kyi gdong bsgyur gnang ba'i phebs rdzongs 'bul chen gyi gong du mchod brjod gleng ba mdor bsdus pa'i 'bul yig gan+dharba'i gling bu/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang sku zhabs su zhu mchid rkang mgyogs grub pa'i pho nya/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhal sngar phul ba'i zhu yig ma lī ka'i phreng ba/ gnas gsar ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dbus su bteg skabs/ sa skyong chen pos phebs rdzongs 'bul chen gong bshad mchod brjod gleng ba mdor bsdus bcas pa'i 'bul yig rkang drug mgrin rnga/

dpal ldan chos skyong gi chos sde'i rten gsum la rab gnas mdzad skabs mchod 'bul gyi gong brjod a dran bsod nams rgyal mtshan khu tsha'i ngor bris pa/ rang nyid kyi shar chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan zhal sngar phul ba'i zhu yig karma zhwa dmar pa dang*/ si tu rin po che lhan cig spyan 'dren zhus pa'i legs 'bul gyi gong bshad/ si tu sprul pa'i skur 'bul ba stob pa'i gong brjod don gnyer gyi ngor bris pa/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul dang si tu pa lhan cig par 'bul ba stob pa'i gong bshad bkra shis rgya mtsho'i ngor bris pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes dbus gtsang phyogs su bteg pa'i skabs sku rdzong 'bul ba'i gong brjod don gnyer ngor bris/ sangs rgyas ye shes chibs skyel dus gleng ba 'di ltar dgos tshul/ sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i bka' phebs ltar bris pa/ khang gsar sku dbon rin po che chos skyong bzang po dbus gtsang bteg pa'i phebs rdzong gi gong brjod/ ngor gyi dpon slob dbu mdzad pa'i drung zhu yig bya ma rta'i ngag snyan/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pa sku mched la 'byor lan rkang drug dbyangs snyan/ lcags ra sprul sku ngag dbang phrin las par phul ba'i zhu yig sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du 'dus tshogs su phul ba'i zhu yig kun dga'i zla ris/ slob bu a gdon la phul ba/ ze chen rab 'byams pa pad ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa nas gsung yig snyan dngags dri za'i rgyud mangs las 'phos pa rten dang bcas pa stsal ba'i zhu lan 'phrin shod mgrin pa'i rdza rnga/ rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong dbus gtsang phyogs su bteg pa'i bzhed don grub nas/ slar mdo khams su phebs pa'i ched brjod maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad/ si tu sprul sku dag 'jang yul chibs bsgyur gnang ba'i dngos po'i khud pa 'bul ba'i gong brjod sa dbang bsod nams mgon po'i bka' phebs ltar bris pa karma zhwa dmar pa dang si tu pa rnam gnyis zhal mjal 'bul tshan gyi gong brjod hor phur thog dpon gyi bskul ngor bris pa/

sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho pa'i sku zhabs su rang nyid sa dkar nas phyir bde bar 'byor pa'i snyan gsan dang mjal dar chabs cig stob pa'i shis brjod dge legs 'dod 'jo/ sangs 260 rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i chos ldan sa 'dzin sogs bsngags 'os rnams la phul ba'i zhu yig rnams yod pa las/ sde srid mi dbang pho la thā ji'i sku zhabs su shis brjod bsngags pa'i me tog man+dā rwa ba don gnyer gyi ngor bris pa/ sde dge bla chen nyid dpa' thang du chibs bsgyur gnang nas yar phebs skabs legs 'bul zhu yig sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan bzhad pa/ sde srid mi'i dbang po pho la thā ji'i sku zhabs su 'bul ba'i 'go brjod ngang mo'i sgra dbyangs/ sde dge lcam dral chos sde pho brang phebs dus rang gi mdun 'jog bgyis pa'i 'bul tho/ sa skyong lcam dral sku 'khor du bcas pa chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du spyan drangs pa'i dga' ston legs 'bul gyi gleng ba rkang drug myos pa'i mgrin glu/ sde dge bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho rgyal thabs su dbang bskur ba'i khri 'bul dus kyi shis brjod mtsho ldan dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ yang gser khri la dbang phyogs gong ma chen po'i las rtags kyi mnga' gsol ba'i tshe legs 'bul gyi gleng ba bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs/ sde srid mi'i dbang phyug chen po la mjal phyag gi rten mtshon 'bul tho'i gong brjod khyab 'jug dgyes pa'i zhabs bsil/ sde srid mi'i dbang po dā chings bā thur ba zhabs brtan smon lam gyi tshigs bcad ut+pal do shal/ yang dā chings bā thur sku zhabs su zhu yig gong brjod don gnyer ngor bris pa/ sde dge blo gros rgya mtsho'i bka' lung gis shog bu 'dir rtsom chos gang rigs shig gyis la bskur zhes phebs par shis brjod du bris nas phul/ sa skyong kun dga' rgya mtsho'i sde'i sku zhabs su 'dzom thog pa yum sras nas lo gsar gyi dga' ston 'byor lan drung yig kun dga' bstan pa'i ngor bris/

sde dge bla brang nas 'dzom thog par sa 'brug lo gsar gyi dga' ston 'bul tshe bris pa/ shis brjod me tog do shal zhes pa sde dge bla chen nas gcung blo gros rgya mtsho dbus gtsang du phebs skyel mdzad pa'i shis brjod du bris/ sa skyong bla ma khri chen pa nyid nas gcung blo gros rgya mtsho lcam sring dbus gtsang nas phebs pa'i dbu thon legs 'bul gyi gong brjod/ rab myos lo gsar shar ba'i dga' ston gyi tshe shis brjod legs 'bul gyi gong brjod du don gnyer ngor bris pa/ hor gyi yul gru skyong ba ma zur chos mdzad par phul ba'i zhu yig rkang drug mgrin glu/ sa skyong bsod nams mgon po dbus gtsang phyogs nas gegs med phebs pa'i tshe sde dge bla chen nyid nas dga' ston stob pa las brtsams pa'i 'bel mchid 'dab stong phreng ba/ bsod nams mgon por chibs pa 'bul du btang ba'i 'phrin yig sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan/ lo gsar gyi dga' ston 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad me tog phreng mdzes/ zhabs brtan grub pa'i snyan sgron 'bul ba'i zhu yig srid 284 zhi'i yon tan dang stobs 'byor bar pas bsdus pa'i yul rnams la bsngags pa las brtsams pa'i zhu yig stob pa'i dper brjod snyan dngags ngag gi 'dod 'jo dkar chag gser mig 'drid pa'i lcags kyu de nyid yan chad la sdeb ma sum brgya dang nyer bdun yod do// ༈ /glegs bam bcu gcig pa shrī gyi rtags can la/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' lung gi dgongs don rnam par 'grel pa'i bstan bcos gangs can pa'i skad du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin rgyun mi chad pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi phyi mo rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i bsod nams kyi sprin phung rgyas par dkrigs pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam ngo mtshar chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba gsar pa zhes bya ba la sdeb ma lnga brgya dang gsum yod do// //slar smras pa/ shākya sras kyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba bdag

/yi ge'i ma mo bslab sbyangs dpyis phyin nas// yab mes bzo rig mkhas pa'i rgyun skyong phyir// sku gsung thugs rten bris 'bur cha tshad bslab// de rjes phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun// mkhyen cing 'doms la bsnyengs bral smra dbang che// karma 'chi med zhabs pad gus bsnyen nas// yig rigs sgra snyan sdeb sbyor mthar phyin bgyis// 'og min gnyis pa e waṃ chos ldan du// mkhas mchog rnams las zab dang rgya che ba'i// legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i skal ba sbom byas nas// skyabs mchog de dag mnyes pa'i zhabs 'gyur bsgrubs// gang tshe 'khor lo'i mgon mchog zhal snga nas// khyod kyis gsar bsgrigs bstan bcos yod do cog /ma 'ongs blo gsal rnams la phan ched du// gyi nar ma bskyur phyogs bsdoms bsags dgos zhes// bka' lung lan gcig min par gtsug gi rgyan// stsal ba deng brten sngon chad dbang khrid lung*// thob kun brgyud pa'i rkang grangs zhib bkral ba'i// pusti gnyis dang gzhan yang don gnyer ngor// gang dag bris pa'i bstan bcos che phra kun// par du bskrun na 'gro don che snyam nas// zla bral bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chos rgyal che'i// thugs rgyud bskul nas chos sbyin par gyi 'phrul// legs par 'grub pa'i glegs bam dbang phyug grangs// spel 'di rang nyid mkhas 'dod nga rgyal dang*// chen po'i sar 'khod khe grags mos blo yis// ma yin gzhan phan sems kyis 'di bgyis so// tshul de'i dge bas nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan// spyi dang bye brag brtse chen snying po'i zhabs// e waṃ par grags zung gi ring lugs dag /sprin dus chu gter che ltar 'phyur bar smon// thub bstan gangs ri'i spo la rtag 'gyings nas// bcu phrag rig pa'i g.yu ral rab rgyas shing*// lung dang rigs pa'i mche rnon gzing ba can// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gdong lnga mngon mtho ba'i// bstan 'dzin mchog rnams bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog

/yangs pa'i nor 'dzin dbang bsgyur mi'i dbang phyug /chos rgyal sde dge dral lcam sras 'khor gyi// chab srid mnga' thang phun sum tshogs gyur nas// bstan 'gro yongs la dge legs 'phel gyur cig /bdag cag gnyen 'khor ltos bcas byang chub bar// dal 'byor rten thob dam pa'i chos dang mjal// bar chad kun zhi legs pa'i yon tan tshogs// 'phel nas 'di phyi kun du dge gyur cig /'chos skyob 'di rnams ji srid bskal pa'i bar// chos min log rtog dri mas ma bslad par// bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun la phan bde'i gzhi// 'bad med gegs bral 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces rang dang skal mnyam ched du nyer mkho sug bris byas pa rnams phyogs su bsdebs pa'i tshan grangs gser mig 'drid pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di'ang shākya'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs rgya chen po 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
